title: A Machine for the Colony
author: Bram Winterbourne
blurb: Astrid Reyes, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
